name: Order Intake
description: Conversational order-intake assistant for property media orders: catalog-based quoting and completeness-checked draft handoff.

basePath.description: URL path the web chat is served under. Defaults to /wow-intake.

brain.description: Intake brain: deterministic slot-filling (scripted, default, no LLM) or the LLM-backed conversational brain.

provider.description: Provider id for the LLM brain (defaults to the agent default model's provider).

model.description: Model id for the LLM brain (defaults to the agent default model).

handoffChannel.description: Where completed order drafts are delivered. Defaults to stub until a channel is configured.

slack.description: Slack handoff settings (used when handoffChannel is "slack"). Provide a webhook URL, or a bot token plus channel. Secrets may also come from the ORDER_INTAKE_SLACK_* env vars.

webhookUrl.description: Slack incoming webhook URL. Preferred: no bot user or OAuth scopes needed.

botToken.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-…) for chat.postMessage. Requires channel.

channel.description: Target channel id or name for the bot-token transport (e.g. #new-orders).
